systems.owner: National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA), with UNDP support
systems.tiers: launched September 2023 with first enrolment centres in Banadir Region; over 1 million registered by November 2025 at 12,000 to 15,000 a day; permanent centres, mobile registration teams and enrolment centres in more than 30 embassies

systems.system: Baidoa IDP national ID registration campaign
systems.owner: NIRA with UNDP, the Federal Government, the Office of the President of South West State and Baidoa Municipality; funded from UNDP's Funding Windows (Luxembourg, Republic of Korea, Denmark)
systems.tiers: one-month campaign with two enrolment centres and registration points at IDP sites in Baidoa; 38,026 people enrolled against a target of 25,000

note: The document is about enrolment in the national identity system and a one-month identity registration drive among displaced people in Baidoa. It states nothing about the registration of births or deaths or about a civil registration office, so no fact is taken.
